title: Nonapplicability.
bodyText: This part shall not apply to measures or measuring devices utilized in public utilities that are subject to measurement standards control under any other statute or rule of the State.
bodyHtml: [§486-123]  Nonapplicability.  This part shall not apply to measures or measuring devices utilized in public utilities that are subject to measurement standards control under any other statute or rule of the State. [L 1991, c 153, pt of §6]
